rules.text: Items can be returned within 30 days of the delivery date with a valid receipt or order number.
rules.quote: We're happy to accept returns for items with a valid receipt or order number within 30 days of the delivery date.

rules.text: Returns require a valid receipt, invoice, or order confirmation; without it, no refund, credit or courtesy exchange will be issued.
rules.quote: We do not accept returns or exchanges without a receipt, invoice, or order confirmation. If you do not have a valid receipt or if we cannot confirm your purchase in our system, no refund, credit or courtesy exchange will be issued.

rules.text: Items marked Clearance or with a price ending in .97 and face coverings are not returnable.
rules.quote: Items marked Clearance or items that have a price ending in .97 are not returnable. Face coverings are also non-returnable.

rules.text: Certain merchandise such as fragrance or swimwear may not be eligible for return unless in original condition.
rules.quote: Certain merchandise such as fragrance or swimwear may not be eligible for return unless in original condition.

rules.text: A $6.99 fee will be deducted from refunds for prepaid return shipping labels, with some exemptions.
rules.quote: $6.99 will be deducted from your refund for the cost of using the prepaid return label. Certain items may be exempt from this deduction.

rules.text: Online exchanges are not offered; customers must return items and place a new order to exchange.
rules.quote: At this time, we don’t offer online exchanges. If you’d like to exchange a product, return it using our Returns process and then place a new order.

rules.text: Online purchases can be returned within 60 days of purchase.
rules.quote: We’re happy to accept returns for items within 60 days of your purchase online.

rules.text: All clearance and final sale items are not eligible for returns, exchanges, price adjustments, or price matches.
rules.quote: All clearance items are considered final sale, meaning no returns or exchanges are allowed. Final sale items do not qualify for price adjustments or price matches.

rules.text: Returns will not be accepted at Express Factory Outlet stores for non-Factory Outlet items purchased elsewhere or online.
rules.quote: Express Factory Outlet stores cannot accept returns for non-Express Factory Outlet items purchased at Express or Express Men retail stores, or online at express.com.
